capabilities: prevent closing pinned tabs with middle-click
provide alternative close commands for hotkey rebinding
disambiguation: It does not pin anything itself; it only protects tabs that are already pinned from being closed.
extras: Installation is manual: clone the repository into .obsidian/plugins and restart Obsidian. The README lists gaps: context menu close buttons are not blocked, and alternative commands for closing tab groups are not provided.
intentEvidence: Enhances standard pin functionality by preventing pinned tabs from being closed.
problem: Obsidian's standard close commands and middle-click close tabs even when they are pinned, so pinned tabs can be closed by accident.
summary: Tab protection plugin that prevents pinned tabs from being closed by middle-click and adds alternative close commands for rebinding.
